**To add Claude CLI to the system PATH for all users, run this in an admin PowerShell:**

```powershell
setx -m PATH "C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-25.0.1.8-hotspot\bin;C:\windows\system32;C:\windows;C:\windows\System32\Wbem;C:\windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\;C:\windows\System32\OpenSSH\;C:\Program Files\Git\cmd;C:\Program Files\GitHub CLI\;C:\Program Files\nodejs\;/home/author\.sentinel\bin"
```

This requires administrator privileges. After running it, all new login shells will have `claude` available on the PATH without any user-specific dotfile edits needed.

Alternatively, if you can't access admin privileges, you can add it to just the current user's PATH with:
```powershell
setx PATH "$env:PATH;/home/author\.sentinel\bin"
```
